expectations.text: Gives a compressed checklist adapted to the 48 hours left rather than a multi-week plan
expectations.evidence: The core of the plan is a section titled 'Last-48-hour actions, ranked by value per hour', with 16 numbered items split into Today (Oct 18, T-2), Tomorrow (Oct 19, T-1) and Launch day (Oct 20, T-0). It also flags org verification as unlikely to finish in time and says not to block the launch on it, and it drops the Daily Papers bump because the window has closed. The post-launch part is a single 'Weeks 1–2' line, not a multi-week plan. It loses a point for compression: the reply also includes repo-layout, gate, AI Act, Space and measurement sections, so it is not a tight checklist.

expectations.text: Gives a compressed checklist adapted to the 48 hours left rather than a multi-week plan
expectations.evidence: Section 3 is titled 'Other things for the next 48 hours' and uses short numbered lists grouped by Model repo, Space and Launch day. The response contains no multi-week plan, and it moves time-sensitive steps forward: 'submit now, not on launch day' and 'Open huggingface.co/papers/submit today'. It is not fully compressed for 48 hours. It has 15 checklist items plus two long sections, but no order, owners or time slots within the 48 hours. Some items are extra scope, such as uploading GGUF and quantized variants. Ambiguity pushes the score down from 5.
